description: Dept. of Elections - Elected Mr. Jayasinghe Arachchige Don Sanath Anil Prasanna as a member of the Negombo Municipal Council
categorisation: This gazette notice concerns the filling of a vacancy in a local government body (Negombo Municipal Council) due to an elected member moving to a provincial council. It details the electoral process for replacing the member under the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance, which falls under electoral processes and related matters.
